scenario.name: r-rc-1-threshold-reject
scenario.description: request_compaction() threshold-REJECT guard. Triggers an agent turn via sessions.send that calls request_compaction on a below-threshold (low-context) session and asserts compaction does NOT fire (the guard held). Non-mutating; gates the irreversible accept path (R-RC-2). Uses the sessions.send agent-turn dispatch path (#134), NOT tools.invoke.

invocation.reasonTemplate: R-RC-1 proof nonce {{nonce}}: below-threshold reject probe.

expectedReceipts.name: agent-turn-triggered
expectedReceipts.description: sessions.send accepted -> an agent turn fired that can call request_compaction (the #134 dispatch path, not a bare tools.invoke RPC)

expectedReceipts.name: no-compaction-fired
expectedReceipts.description: No compaction/summarization lifecycle event on the below-threshold session (the guard held; nothing mutated)

expectedReceipts.name: reject-reason-threshold
expectedReceipts.description: Rejection/threshold-decline citing the context-usage guard surfaced in the agent turn output (soft corroborator; not always emitted on the WS stream)

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID from the turn for Tempo fetch

review.notes: Threshold-REJECT path via the sessions.send agent-turn dispatch (#134): non-mutating safety proof. PASS-candidate when an agent turn is triggered AND no compaction fires on a genuinely below-threshold session. reject-reason is a soft corroborator. Must run on a genuinely low-context session (fresh/idle main). candidateSha + seat resolved from env at runtime. Run BEFORE R-RC-2 (the accept path).
